content: Next.js + Spring Cloud Gateway cookies/CORS: localhost:3000 vs localhost:8080 are DIFFERENT origins (port counts) so CORS applies even locally. Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true requires explicit allowed origin (* is rejected by browsers/Spring). SameSite=Lax recommended; Strict breaks post-login redirects; None requires Secure which breaks plain-http dev. secure flag must be NODE_ENV-dependent. Next.js SSR/server-component fetch does NOT persist Set-Cookie automatically - browser handles client-side fetches only; server routes must forward cookie headers manually via cookies() API. Cleanest pattern: same-origin catch-all proxy route in Next (or rewrites) eliminating CORS entirely, proxy translating cookie<->header for the gateway.
